budget_note: Historical estimated-cost settings; review provider pricing before a new collection.
primary_metric: On the common all-three-valid subset, compare trait changes relative to the same new anchor: reordered minus identical-repeat flip rate, equal-book mean.
inference: Two-sided exact book sign flips, Holm across two primary comparisons, book-level t 95% CI. Require nonempty valid triples in all ten books or mark primary inference unavailable. Book independence/symmetry assumptions; shared authors; fixed corpus.
missing_policy: Report all 120-group coverage; never count invalid outputs as stable traits. For all-group sensitivity, report operational non-reproduction (invalid or changed) and worst-case [-1,+1] bounds for incomplete triples.
secondary: F-minus-E contrast on common all-six-valid items
shared exact quotations among changed traits
fixed traceability/stability selection rules with coverage and within-book random-retention expectation
collection: All 1440 jobs randomly interleaved with no shared chat history. Anchor is a reference call designation, not necessarily the first chronologically. Same-order and rotation variants collected anew, never reused from the first batch.
sampling: 12 IDs per book sampled by fixed hash from original 600, ignoring prior outcomes. Nonzero option rotations balanced 3 each of shifts 1..4 within each book. No outcome-dependent replacement or expansion.
failure_policy: Same strict parser as main study; no repair or resampling of malformed/refused/truncated model answers. Transient API errors at most two attempts; exhausted jobs retained separately. Billing/auth/config errors stop collection. No inferential output before all planned jobs reach terminal status.

documented_model_versions.deepseek: deepseek-flash maps to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; mutable alias, not pinned weights
documented_model_versions.glm: glm-4.6; provider does not expose a dated weight revision
